title: session.changed — Mode Switch Confirmed
description: Server confirms a pipeline mode change, or (for mode=config) that a session config change was applied. Sent in response to session.change.

mode.description: The now-active pipeline mode, except for control confirmations: 'config' confirms a session.change(mode=config) request and does NOT mean the pipeline mode changed. 'transcribe' = ASR-only live transcription (no LLM, no TTS; pipeline only). 'omni' = full-modality realtime model (single stream: audio+image in, text+audio out; requires server omni provider).

my_language.description: Echo of the user's language (only present in translate mode).

local_language.description: Echo of the local language (only present in translate mode).

usecase.description: Echo of the translation usecase (only meaningful when mode=translate).

avdetector.description: Echo of the per-session AVDetector switch. Present only in responses to session.change(mode=config).
